query:
SELECT
                         c.id AS "id: _",
                         c.name,
                         c.group_master_key,
                         c.group_revision,
                         c.group_members AS "group_members: _",
                         c.muted AS "muted: _",
                         c.expire_timer
                    FROM channels c
                    ORDER BY (
                        SELECT MAX(m.arrived_at)
                        FROM messages m
                        WHERE m.channel_id = c.id AND m.edit IS NULL
                    )
